best graph
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(darkTriad_Data_1, aes(Psychopathy)) + geom_histogram(fill = "pink", color = "purple") + theme_light() + labs(x = "Psychopathy Score", y = "Count of Psychopathy Score", title = "Psychopathy Score")
```
worst graph
```{r}
ggplot(darkTriad_Data_1, aes(Psychopathy)) +geom_bar(fill = "red")+ geom_histogram() 
```


narcissim 

best graph
```{r}
library(viridis)
darkTriad2 <- darkTriad_Data_1 |> filter(country == "US"| country == "CA" | country == "GB")
ggplot(darkTriad2, aes(Narcissism, Psychopathy, color = country)) + geom_point() + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Purples") + theme_light() + labs(x = "Nacrissism Score", y = "Psychopathy Score", title = "Association between Psychopathy and Narcissism Score")
```

worst graph
```{r}

ggplot(darkTriad_Data_1, aes(Narcissism, Psychopathy)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~source)+ theme_dark() + theme(text = element_text(family = "mono", size = 100))
```
